---
title: "Password Cracking Benchmark Analysis"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

df <- read.csv("benchmark.csv")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    pwd_length = nchar(password),
    attempts_per_sec = attempts / cracktime_s
  )

hw_labels <- c("cpu" = "Ryzen 7 5700X", "gpu" = "RTX 5060")
hw_colors <- c("cpu" = "#E69F00", "gpu" = "#56B4E9")
```

```{r}
df_longest <- df %>% filter(pwd_length == 6) %>% head(10)

ggplot(df_longest, aes(x = password, y = cracktime_s, fill = hardware)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hw_colors, labels = hw_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Crack Time Comparison: CPU vs GPU",
    subtitle = "Execution time for 6-character passwords (log scale)",
    x = "Password",
    y = "Time (seconds)",
    fill = "Hardware Architecture"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
df_summary_len <- df %>%
  group_by(pwd_length, hardware) %>%
  summarize(avg_time = mean(cracktime_s), .groups = 'drop')

ggplot(df_summary_len, aes(x = pwd_length, y = avg_time, color = hardware, group = hardware)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hw_colors, labels = hw_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Exponential Growth of Cracking Time",
    subtitle = "Average time vs. password length variation",
    x = "Password Length (characters)",
    y = "Average Time (seconds)",
    color = "Hardware Architecture"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

```{r}
df_throughput <- df %>%
  group_by(hardware) %>%
  summarize(median_hashrate = median(attempts_per_sec), .groups = 'drop')

ggplot(df_throughput, aes(x = hardware, y = median_hashrate, fill = hardware)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-9, suffix = " B")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hw_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = hw_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Hardware Throughput Capability",
    subtitle = "Median Hash Rate (Attempts per Second)",
    x = "Hardware Architecture",
    y = "Attempts per Second (Billions)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = attempts, y = cracktime_s, color = hardware)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, size = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-9, suffix = "B")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hw_colors, labels = hw_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Time Scaling Efficiency",
    subtitle = "Relationship between total combinations tested and time taken",
    x = "Total Combinations Tested (Billions)",
    y = "Time Taken (seconds)",
    color = "Hardware Architecture"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```
